title: Schönberg's journal of the Dresden negotiations (Wettin houses / Electoral Mainz, Erfurt affair), Dresden, early December 1665: one cipher passage on Boyneburg and 30,000 thalers (LATh - StA Altenburg, Schönbergische Sammlung Nr. 107, fol. 114r)

documents.shelfmark: Landesarchiv Thüringen - Staatsarchiv Altenburg, Schönbergische Sammlung (1-99-0023), Nr. 107 (Acta Reiffenbergica), fol. 114r (image 0233)

plaintext.source: none: no decipherment of the time in the volume (396 images checked)

transcription.notes: One AI transcriber, frozen before any key was tried (frozen/H-CHIFFRE.txt); five sign errors corrected after the measurement on re-reading the image (A/W capitals read as L, q/g, t/b), the frozen file left unchanged.

system.summary: Simple substitution in Latin letters with a regular key over a 24-letter alphabet: odd plaintext letters -> z y x w ... n (reversed), even -> a b c ... m. Word division kept.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment of the time in Nr. 107; no edition of Schönberg's journal or of the passage found (LATh and ThULB records, web searches; printed histories of the Erfurt affair not checked volume by volume); nothing in this repository (catalogue, leads, key_leads, candidates, issues; re-checked 9 Nov 2026).

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout set the rules (protocol hashed after the transcription freeze and before any key, one held-out measurement, thresholds fixed in advance). AI agents transcribed, solved, measured and read. No human palaeographer checked the transcription.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Known keys tried first on the learning lines (Thumbshirn's key of Nr. 85, numeric; Dresden HStA nomenclators): none applies.
Simple substitution solved on lines L1-L5 only (German), key frozen before the held-out lines were decoded.
One measurement on held-out lines L6-L9 (16 words): German lexicon share 0.625 vs best of 200 shuffled keys 0.3125 (margin 0.31); partial by thresholds fixed in advance (validated >= 0.70).

Key completed from its regular pattern and five transcription errors corrected after the measurement (declared); 32 words: 25 certain, 4 probable, 2 restored at the binding edge, 1 unresolved; 29/32 = 90.6% read by sense without the restored words.

outcome.method_basis: Simple substitution solved from the cipher alone on the learning lines; measured once on the held-out lines (partial); the key is regular and was completed from its pattern.

validation.notes: Contributor's pre-registered held-out test (not docs/_validate.py): lexicon share 0.625 vs best shuffled 0.3125 on 16 words; partial. Transcription errors corrected after the measurement (A/W read as L, q/g, t/b); the frozen transcription was not modified.

outcome.fraction_read_source: reading_0233.md: 29 of 32 words certain or probable (25 + 4); 2 restored at the binding edge and 1 unresolved are not counted.

credits.note: transcription, key recovered from the cipher (partial on held-out lines), reading 29/32 words; images LATh - StA Altenburg / ThULB Jena, CC BY 3.0

gaps.item: one word, 'diengs' (cipher buxswi), read letter by letter but of uncertain sense; two letters lost in the binding (ge[w]onnen, [T]eufel)
gaps.detail: the letters are certain; the sense of 'diengs' (Dings? dienst?) and the two binding-edge letters need a reader of the original

texts.label: fol. 114r (image 0233), Dresden, early December 1665
texts.summary: Boyneburg says a great deal: the Elector is said to have obtained 30,000 thalers 'pro iuribus Erfordensibus' (for the Erfurt rights); he swore to his people 'may the devil take me' and called people to witness it.

reading_review.note: reads as German sentences; 29/32 words by sense (90.6%), 2 restored at the binding edge, 1 unresolved word; key partial on its held-out test; transcription errors corrected after the measurement (A/W read as L, q/g, t/b), the frozen H file unchanged

outcome.notes: New text: no decipherment of the time, no edition found. Images: ThULB Jena digitisation, CC BY 3.0 (credit Landesarchiv Thüringen - Staatsarchiv Altenburg, Schönbergische Sammlung Nr. 107). Same archive as thumbshirn1647 (Nr. 85, another volume).
